title: Credo à 5 (de Orto)
desc: Marbrianus de Orto, Credo à 5. 5 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor 1, Tenor 2, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Ort1009); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
